plan.title: pr-wait-mergeable misclassifies missing pr-monitor CLI path as cap-reached

narratives.Description: pr-wait-mergeable misclassifies missing pr-monitor CLI path as cap-reached
narratives.Overview:
## Problem

`task pr:wait-mergeable-and-merge` / `deft pr-wait-mergeable` fails immediately on a packaged npm install because `cliScriptPath("pr-monitor")` resolves to a non-existent nested `@deftai/cli` path. Node exits 1 for module-not-found, and `classifyMonitorOutcome` maps every monitor exit `1` to `cap-reached` / `TIMEOUT-OR-ESCALATION`.

This is the same `cliScriptPath` residual family as #2667 / #2615, but a different entrypoint and a different false outcome label:

| sibling | missing entrypoint | false outcome |
|---|---|---|
| #2667 | `pr-protected-issues.js` | `protected-linked` |
| **this** | `pr-monitor.js` | `cap-reached` |

The CLI file **is** published; resolution never finds it.

## Reproduction

Observed on Windows with `@deftai/directive@0.79.3` (global npm) while shepherding Dependabot PRs in `deftai/cartograph` (2026-07-20):

```text
task -t .deft/core/Taskfile.yml pr:wait-mergeable-and-merge -- 112 --repo deftai/cartograph
```

Immediate failure (~2s), not a wait-budget timeout:

```text
Error: Cannot find module '.../@deftai/directive/node_modules/@deftai/cli/dist/pr-monitor.js'

[pr_wait_mergeable] PR #112 repo=deftai/cartograph result=TIMEOUT-OR-ESCALATION outcome=cap-reached
```

Meanwhile the file exists at the published package root:

```text
.../node_modules/@deftai/directive/dist/pr-monitor.js   # present
```

Standalone merge-ready on the same PR succeeded:

```text
task -t .deft/core/Taskfile.yml pr:merge-ready -- 112
=> MERGE-READY (Greptile skipped / author excluded; CI green)
```

Manual atomic merge then worked (`pr:merge-ready` + `gh pr merge --squash --delete-branch --admin`).

## Root cause (path candidates)

In `@deftai/directive-core` `pr-wait-mergeable/wrappers.js` `cliScriptPath()`:

1. `require.resolve("@deftai/directive/package.json")` → **`ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED`**  
   (`@deftai/directive` `exports` only expose "."`; `package.json` is not exported.)
2. Monorepo fallback `../../../cli/dist/pr-monitor.js` → resolves to nested `@deftai/cli/...` which **does not exist** on npm.
3. Nested npm fallback `../../../../dist/pr-monitor.js` → **off-by-one**; lands in `directive/node_modules/dist`, not `directive/dist`.
4. Final fallback returns the dead monorepo path → Node `MODULE_NOT_FOUND` → exit 1 → `cap-reached`.

Verified with `createRequire` from the installed wrappers.js location on 0.79.3:

```text
c1 FAIL ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED
c2 .../directive/node_modules/@deftai/cli/dist/pr-monitor.js  false
c3 .../directive/node_modules/dist/pr-monitor.js              false
c3fixed (.../../../../../../dist/pr-monitor.js)              true
actual .../directive/dist/pr-monitor.js                       true
```

## Expected

- Resolve packaged CLI entrypoints (`pr-monitor.js`, and the shared helper used by protected-check) correctly under the published `@deftai/directive` layout.
- Treat module-not-found / wrapper spawn failure as **config error** (exit 2), not as `cap-reached` / timeout-or-escalation.
- Preserve `cap-reached` only for a real monitor budget exhaustion after a successful spawn.

## Workaround

Use the manual freshness-window gate instead of the composed cascade verb:

```text
task pr:merge-ready -- <N>
gh pr merge <N> --squash --delete-branch --admin
```

## Related

- #2667 — same `cliScriptPath` residual; protected-check → `protected-linked`
- #2615 — original packaged-layout fix that this residual escaped
- #1369 — cascade automation surface that routes agents through this verb

## Environment

- OS: win32
- `@deftai/directive@0.79.3` (global npm under `%APPDATA%\npm\node_modules`)
- Consumer repo: `deftai/cartograph`

---

## Issue comment thread

_The issue body is the original write-up; maintainer comments below may supersede it. Read the full thread before building a dispatch envelope (#2143)._

### Comment by @MScottAdams (2026-07-20T14:55:25Z)

## Triage / cohort intake

**Verdict: confirmed accurate** — sibling of #2667 (same `cliScriptPath` residual from #2615).

| | missing entrypoint | false outcome |
| --- | --- | --- |
| #2667 | `pr-protected-issues.js` | `protected-linked` |
| **#2673** | `pr-monitor.js` | `cap-reached` |

Root cause already verified on `@deftai/directive@0.79.3`: `ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED` on `package.json` resolve → dead `@deftai/cli` fallback → Node exit 1 → misclassified.

**Cohort plan:** Fold into swarm group `bugs-2662-2671` as an amendment to the #2667 leaf (same `wrappers.ts` / cascade classify paths). One PR should close both #2667 and #2673.
